description: An iMessage-faithful chat UI for SwiftUI on iOS 18+. One view renders bubbles with tails, typing indicators, delivery states, attachments, keyboard handling, and pagination.
rules: Import the SwiftChat product: `import SwiftChat`. The older `import UnionChat` still works but is deprecated.
Build a transcript with `Chat(messages) { Message($0.text, role: $0.role, timestamp: $0.sentAt) }` where `messages` is any RandomAccessCollection of Identifiable values.
Show typing dots with `.chatTypingIndicators([ChatRole])`, which must be applied directly to Chat before other modifiers.
Handle sending with `.onChatSend { text, media in ... }`; `text` is optional and `media` is an array of MessageMedia (may be empty).
For AI assistant threads use `.chatStyle(.assistant)`: the question rises to the top and the reply streams in as bare Markdown text.
Requires iOS 18 and Xcode 26.1 (the binary module interface is built with Swift 6.2).
